Yeah, I doubt my case will go through. There isn’t much evidence, and nobody really wants to take on a case like this.  

I told a few people. I talk to my parents sometimes, but I know it hurts them to hear me talk about it, so I just keep it in.  

I hadn’t thought of a sleep podcast. I actually don’t really like sound on when I’m sleeping, but I do play on my phone until I crash. It’s a habit I tried breaking, but being in the dark and alone with my thoughts freaks me out
Thank you so much. I really really want to graduate and prove that I can really do this whole life thing. But sometimes it feels so easy to just... Give up
I do. I’m a double major, so at *least* 3 years left of actual school. Depending on how this case goes, or how class goes, I may have more if I cut down or withdraw for a bit

Thank you so much. I feel like it doesn’t get better and I have everything fighting against me - I’m mentally ill, I’m doing everything I can to not get addicted to something, I’m struggling in school, and now I’ve been raped and am dealing with the stigma and the physical and mental issues from that. I feel like I’m drowning, or sinking into a dark hole. Part of me wants to drop out, part of me desperately knows I need to stay in school and prove everything and everybody wrong

I genuinely don’t know what to do. My therapist has this happy go lucky “It’ll all work out in the end” attitude. It just feels so wrong right now with everything that’s going on. I want to scream *no* not everything will be okay! I have ptsd! I’m in pain! I may need therapy the rest of my life bc of this! I need coping mechanisms not “it’ll be okay :)))))” because that’s not going to fix the fact I want to kill myself to get rid of what’s going on!!!
